question: Can concurrent independent FX quote requests improve timely authorized settlement while preserving exact policy outcomes?
changed_factor: Sequential versus parallel BPMN ordering of the three independent quote requests
population: Equal synthetic coverage of 22 fixed policy/fault cases crossed with three declared quote-delay profiles; not measured customer/provider latency or traffic frequency

design.primary_outcome: Paired change in correct settlements observed within two seconds per measured second
design.stop_rule: Stop on invalid accounting, incorrect/unsafe outcomes, source/control drift, reset, generator, telemetry, worker-evidence or cost-window failure. Retain every attempt. Deadline misses remain results and never justify replacing an arm.

runtime.topology: Engine, generator, quote backend and worker share one controller; separate fresh managed PostgreSQL node.

worker_attempts.scope: Worker task attempts and fetch failures; backend replays are counted separately. Not every network packet or provider retry.

telemetry_scope: Shared controller CPU/memory, engine/backend/worker container status, SQL counters and TLS. Managed-database CPU and complete distributed tracing were not collected.
source_preservation_method: Full content hashes at complete timestamp-group prefixes selected by the two independently captured snapshot row counts.

cleanup.late_receipt_followup: The final control-plane recheck encountered expired authentication after the workload audit and confirmed database deletion. Isolated sign-in was renewed; retained DELETED identity plus fresh authorized absence and all five session closures/expiries were reconciled. No benchmark arm was repeated.

raw_evidence_location: Retained privately on the operator workstation and controller; raw ledgers, database dumps, credentials and environment metadata are excluded from the source export.
limits: Equal synthetic coverage of 22 fixed policy/fault cases crossed with three declared quote-delay profiles; not measured customer/provider latency or traffic frequency
Scheduled arrival to first durable completion-history observation; includes 100 ms observer polling. Verification reads are separate, not pure engine time.

Preserve original eligibility/expiry and expected outcomes. The deliberately expired and not-yet-valid quotes stay in their declared states. Decision-dependent expiry crossings need a separate protocol.
The functional-only long three-way overlap assertion is disabled in this derived timing population; observed overlap is reported, not required for a performance arm to pass

Five paired changes with their median and range, not a confidence interval. Refusals and safe stops are not settlement throughput. No maximum-capacity, live-agent, real-market, production sizing or complete-cost claim.
Immutable registrar-bound synthetic input; signed-intent, real FX-provider, external payment-network and live-agent integration are separate gates.
This is a one-controller study with a separate database, not a comparison with the four-host reference or another cloud.

Parallel measurement produced 910 cached backend replays versus zero sequentially. The separate post-run diagnostic reconciles engine optimistic-lock HTTP 500 errors, worker retries and cached receipts. This is overhead, not an extra payment effect, a new FX-provider call or a count of all network traffic.
next_gate: Reconcile the remaining original research families; qualify real workload/authority integrations and an appropriate matched live-agent versus rules experiment before extending these findings.

retry_diagnosis.measured_scope: Five performance pairs, excluding qualification and warmup
retry_diagnosis.interpretation: Concurrent execution-entity updates produced engine HTTP 500 optimistic-lock errors. Worker HTTP-error retries match cached backend replays, with outcomes verified by the separate performance audit.
retry_diagnosis.scope: Post-run diagnosis of the retained attempt; not a new optimization comparison or a count of every network request.
retry_diagnosis.collection: Read-only collection of credential-redacted retained engine logs after performance completion. Separate from the sealed measurement archive.
retry_diagnosis.initial_audit_correction: The first diagnostic aggregate combined qualification measurement with performance measurement (943). The corrected auditor explicitly separates study stage and phase: 910 measured performance replays and 33 qualification measurement replays. Raw measurements and per-lane counts are unchanged; the earlier diagnostic output is retained privately.
